title: Quick Vegetarian Egg-Lemon Soup with Brown Rice
description: This vegetarian egg-lemon soup is simple, quick, easy, and so delicious, made hearty with instant brown rice and brightened with fresh lemon.
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked instant brown rice (such as Minute®)
1 pinch dried dill weed, or more to taste
1 pinch granulated garlic, or more to taste
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring broth to a boil in a large saucepan. Add rice. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring soup occasionally, until rice is very tender, about 10 minutes.
Whisk eggs in a large bowl; add lemon juice. Ladle about 1 cup of hot soup into the egg-lemon mixture; pour slowly and stir constantly so that the eggs do not curdle.
Stir egg mixture into the soup in the saucepan. Season with dill, garlic, salt, and pepper. Cook and stir over low heat until eggs are cooked, about 3 minutes more.
